commands.name: list-docs
commands.summary: List every documentation set on DevDocs with its slug, version, release, mtime and size. Use the slug in the other commands.

commands.name: list-entries
commands.summary: List all entries (name, path, type) in one documentation set's search index. DevDocs search is done on the client against this list, so filter the result by name to search.

commands.name: list-types
commands.summary: List the categories (types) of one documentation set, with entry counts and slugs, e.g. 'Branching and Merging' for git or 'Elements' for html.

commands.name: get-doc-home
commands.summary: Get the HTML home/overview page of one documentation set.

commands.name: get-page
commands.summary: Get the HTML content of one documentation page, using the slug and an entry path from list-entries.

commands.name: download-doc
commands.summary: Download the full offline bundle of one documentation set: a JSON object that maps each page path to its HTML. This can be very large.
